response.justification: Bogdan brings genuine staff-level experience, including a current role explicitly building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, which aligns well with the AI-native mindset the role demands, plus solid distributed/high-throughput systems exposure from his time at Dunnhumby. However, the resume shows no explicit Python experience (a stated must-have), and lacks clear evidence of on-call/incident ownership, structured agile/scrum participation, or cross-functional stakeholder management, making his fit uncertain without further clarification.
strengths: Currently a Staff Software Engineer building AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflow frameworks — direct alignment with an AI-native engineering environment
Proven high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems experience handling millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby
19+ years of broad, polyglot technical experience (web, mobile, embedded, GIS platforms) demonstrating strong systems thinking and adaptability
concerns: No explicit Python experience listed anywhere in skills or work history, despite it being a core must-have
No clear evidence of on-call/incident response ownership or operational monitoring responsibilities
Limited explicit indication of cross-functional stakeholder management or formal agile/scrum ceremony experience
